title: Sparse race movement evidence
$comment: Rows are tick,x,y,heading,vx,vy,elevated,jump_height. Tick zero is required; ticks strictly increase. Fast checks require <=6 tick gaps, exact input-count finish, car speed/acceleration/displacement plausibility and every ordered road gate. Ambiguous movement, old recordings, rewinds and creator tests use full replay verification. This is intentionally not exact anti-cheat physics validation. Normal inputs and receipt envelopes are unchanged. Capture forces lap-end samples. Negotiated by bootstrap.lightweight_race_proofs; evidence is immutable with the saved upload.
